rationale: Five observed points: attempt-00 (M32/N64/K32/stages3/swz0) = 147.72us, 18KB smem, 5 blocks/SM; attempts 01-04 (M32/N64/K64/stages2 with swz 16/8/4/0) all = 147.6675us, 24KB smem, 4 blocks/SM, identical 33.816576MB DRAM. Latency is flat within ~0.05us and DRAM is exactly invariant across swizzle 0/4/8/16 and block_K 32/64. With M=32 and block_M=32, reuse=min(swizzle or 1, ceil(32/32))=1 always, so the serpentine panel-reuse hypothesis has no structural leverage and observed DRAM confirms it does not materialize. I keep block_M pinned to 32 (only exact divisor of M=32; 64/128 cannot tile it) and retain swizzle [0,4,8,16] so the solver is not artificially narrowed. Traffic weight cut to 0.3 and launches to 0.3 because both are observed-invariant on this shape; pipeline weight kept at 1.5 to preserve favor for the stages-3/K-32 configuration that tied the best latency with the smallest footprint (18KB, 5 blocks/SM), and footprint weight kept at 1 to bias toward the high-occupancy region. shared_memory_limit stays at the hard 32768 portability cap; estimate max(2*block_K*(block_M+block_N)*num_stages, 4*block_M*block_N) plus exact divisibility of N=K=4096 bound feasibility. Unexplored tuples that may differentiate: block_N=128 (halves N tiles, larger B tile footprint), block_K=32 with stages=2, and block_K=64 with stages=3. Next hypothesis: block_N=128 or stages=3/K=64 combinations may shift block count/occupancy enough to break the latency plateau; if simulator remains ~147.7us with unchanged DRAM, treat the shape as latency-flat and finalize the smallest-footprint stages-3 point. Scope: simulated_us/simulated_dram_mb are GB10 simulator estimates, not hardware measurements; Metal numerically checks the exact source/TIR/config but does not execute the CUDA binary. Local revision from five observed points, not a global optimality claim.
